description: This file defines an interface named AuthParamsInterface within the OrangeHRM security/authentication module. The interface declares two methods for retrieving authentication credentials and attributes, serving as a contract for implementing classes related to authentication parameters.

classes.name: AuthParamsInterface
classes.description: An interface that specifies methods to access authentication credential and attributes within the OrangeHRM authentication module.

methods.name: getCredential
methods.description: Returns an instance of UserCredentialInterface or null, representing the user's credentials.

methods.name: getAttributeBag
methods.description: Returns an instance of AuthAttributeBagInterface or null, representing additional authentication attributes.
